entities.summary: Nilson Machado dos Santos, commonly known as Biro Jade, is a Brazil born, Azerbaijani futsal player who played for Araz Naxçivan. He won Golden Boot award as join top scorer with five goals in UEFA European Futsal Championship 2010. He is now an assistant manager in Azerbaijan national futsal team.
